description.value: The Mount Pleasant Branch of the Vancouver Public Library is a public branch library serving the Mount Pleasant neighbourhood at the corner of Kingsway. As part of the VPL system, it offers community programming and public access resources in one of Vancouver's most cycling-friendly urban neighbourhoods. For touring cyclists it represents a convenient urban rest stop with public access in a lively, bikeable part of the city.
